name: @workspace/tool-logic-markdown-preview
description: The Markdown Preview tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/markdown-preview.md): markdown-it with the specification's flavour and rules (task lists, alignment classes, images and links that load nothing), and the allowlist that rebuilds its output as new nodes of a Document passed in. Pure TypeScript: no React, no chrome; the DOM only through that parameter.
